|strategy=By Michael Sharp, Gold 29

What more can you say? This is [[Darth Vader]], perhaps one of the most used and most loved Star Wars CCG cards.

With power of 6 he is definately a character of choice in battles, and also has the nice touch of adding +1 to EACH battle destiny draw. So now you don't need to worry about drawing that location that you know is coming up. All this and he's immune to attrition &lt;5.

Combos:

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] - What an awesome combo! Power 10, a +1 to battle destiny draws, and the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws!

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] + [[Vader's Cape]] (deployed on [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]]) - POWER COMBO! Power 10, a +1 +1 to battle destiny draws, the ability to cancel one of the Light Side's destiny draws, and both are immune to attrition &lt;5!
|rulings=* This card is a Black Squadron pilot.
* [[Darth Vader]] + [[I Have You Now]] Add one battle destiny (two if Rebel is [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]) if a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle.
* [[Darth Vader]] + [[Force Field]] Cancels an attempt to target a Dark Jedi with a character weapon.
